The pasted form has many tempting shapes: order 999999999, placeholder IBAN DE00 0000 0000 0000 0000 00, example email nobody@example.invalid, and reserved address 198.51.100.8. The generated labels are napoleon@example.net, DE82761706604429383284, 2001:db8:19e3:5a6f::db00, 4885 6232 1758 2403, and 0x2dA2a9B220558250C05c6A656d330383D402f5A4. This fixture keeps unlabeled bait near real generated spans to stress false-positive handling.
